title: Remove Punctuation
description:
Given the string `"Hello, World! It's a great day... isn't it?"`, remove all punctuation characters (`.,!?'`) and print the cleaned string. Then print the word count of the cleaned string.

**Expected output:**
```
Hello World Its a great day isnt it
Word count: 8
```
starterCode:
# Write your code here
text = "Hello, World! It's a great day... isn't it?"
expectedOutput:
Hello World Its a great day isnt it
Word count: 8
hint: Loop through chars and keep only those not in the punctuation set. Then split and count the words.
